name: 01 · The Missing Employee
description: Compare the staff directory, preserved event register and archived notices. Match both case and timestamp. Open the Stage 1 archive at {archive_url}.

hints.content: Check announcements older than the directory.
Match both case reference and UTC meeting time.

name: 02 · More Than a Photograph
description: Recover Maya’s note from the original PNG obtained in Stage 1. Read red-channel least-significant bits, row-major, MSB-first bytes, UTF-8 to NUL. Preserve the original.

name: 03 · Someone Used Her Name
description: Use APR-0217 to compare policy, transaction and audit records at {portal_url}. Submit the corroborating pair to release the encrypted warning.

hints.content: Authentication and approval permission are different.
Match the accepted audit event to the policy and transaction.

name: 04 · The Administrator’s Warning
description: Decrypt Elias’s message using the supplied training memo. Submit the recovered flag, then request northstar_evidence.img from your organizer. Check its SHA-256 before analysis.

hints.content: A=0; only ASCII letters advance the key, including across lines.

name: 05A · Recover the Deleted Handover
description: Recover the deleted handover from the 64 MiB FAT16 raw image (filesystem offset zero). Correlate SESSION.LOG, AUDIT.JSL and RELEASE.CSV. Retain the service, UTC window and trusted manifest hash. Ask the organizer for Stage 6 access after scoring.

hints.content: The visible file list is incomplete.
Enumerate deleted entries and recover the handover.

name: 05B · Reconstruct the Missing Minutes
description: Join case and session records and identify the UTC window. Construct FLAG{st05b_<service>_<startHHMM>_<endHHMM>} using the literal lowercase service and four-digit times. Retain the trusted manifest hash.

hints.content: Compare preserved sessions with the export.
Join by case and session; use UTC start and end.

name: 06 · The Wrong Recovery Route
description: Use your issued analyst SSH account to investigate /srv/northstar. Authenticate the manifest and then its route. Submit release, route, service and redirection event at {verifier_url}, then submit the returned flag here.

hints.content: Inspect the pointer and its history.
Authenticate the manifest first, then check its route hash.
